payload.reason: The evidence indicates that LSTM and GRU with Attention outperformed all other models in offensive language identification tasks, making them the best-performing methods.

claims.text: LSTM and GRU with Attention outperformed all other models in terms of macro-F1, precision, and recall for both Offensive and Not Offensive classes.
Deep learning approaches, particularly LSTM and GRU with Attention, are more effective than traditional classifiers like SVM and SGDC for offensive language detection.
